history.note: React #419 fixed: identity.ts guarded localStorage for the static render; _layout.tsx mounts the route tree after hydration via useIsHydrated(). Verified zero page/console errors on menu, match-lobby, replay-library (classic) and match-dealt (3d); full legacy Playwright suite 103 passed / 1 skipped.

issues.title: Desktop: dice pair straddles the Tutorial card's top-right corner
issues.detail: At 1440x900 the hero dice sit at roughly (1215-1275, 305-355) CSS px while the Tutorial GlassCard's top-right corner is at (1255, 343). The zoomed crop shows one die half behind the glass (blurred, dimmed, with the card shadow across it) and half crisp outside — exactly the half-sharp/half-blurred straddle the occluder band exists to prevent. The dice are hero-adjacent, not drift tiles, so they bypass occluderFactor and are placed purely by layout. Fix: either run the dice resting position through the same occluder/keep-out test in reseedForOccluders (nudge them ~40 px up-right until factor >= 0.9), or move the desktop dice to the open void right of the fan's 中中 end where nothing is registered. Reproduce with the desktop menu shot; verify the die is fully clear of every glass rect.

issues.title: Phone portrait: drift tiles ghost inside the MATCH CODE input and across the Join match CTA
issues.detail: Behind the Online match card five or more drift tiles are seeded 'deep behind glass', but the 0.62 glass + 16 px blur does not swallow them: a green 索 face sits inside the match-code input right next to the ABCDE placeholder, a tile back overlaps the 'Join match' label, and two more sit around the input's right end. In the highest-attention form area this reads as debris behind the form rather than depth, and desktop cards show far fewer tiles behind them so the phone card looks comparatively busy. Fix options, cheapest first: (a) register the TextInput wrapper and the primary button as 'solid' occluders via useMenuOccluder('solid') so tiles fade anywhere inside them; (b) cap the factor for tiles fully inside a glass rect at ~0.35 so they read as faint depth cues; (c) in reseedForOccluders reserve the Online match card for far-depth tiles only. Reduced-motion phone (which has no drift field) shows how much calmer the card reads without them.

issues.title: Landscape phone lesson sheet hard-clips the third card with no trailing inset
issues.detail: The horizontal lesson rail inside the Tutorial glass sheet has a ~24 px inset on the left (card 01 starts at x 233 vs sheet edge 218) but zero on the right: card 03 'Reading the table' is cut by the sheet's inner border at x 697, with the sheet stroke drawn over it. The asymmetry makes the clip look accidental. Fix: add contentContainerStyle paddingRight equal to the left inset (or a partial 'peek' width so the third card is clearly cut mid-card), and/or a 24 px linear-gradient mask on the trailing edge of the scroller so the clip fades instead of ending on a hard line.

issues.title: Landscape replay library: Import button floats mid-header
issues.detail: Import replays spans x 464-662 CSS px while the FULLSCREEN chip starts at x 807, leaving a ~145 px void; the button ends up neither right-aligned nor centred, just parked at the edge of the 236 px chrome keep-out. Fix: right-align Import to the chip's left edge with a 12 px gap (measure the chip strip, not the fixed 236 px band) or, when the chip is present, drop Import below the title row on the left so the header reads Lobby / Replays / Import as one aligned cluster.

issues.title: Reduced-motion portrait backdrop has no visible drift field (known gap confirmed)
issues.detail: With animations off on portrait the backdrop shows only the rack and dice; every seeded drift tile sits behind glass and is invisible, so the portrait reduced-motion scene is measurably less rich than landscape/desktop reduced-motion, which are fully populated. It still looks clean rather than broken, so this is low. Fix: for the frozen field, seed the driftVisible tiles into the open bands portrait actually has — the side margins of the hero band (x < 12% and x > 88%) and the strip below the last card — instead of behind the cards; or lower driftVisible for reduced-motion portrait and document the decision in ARCHITECTURE.md.

issues.title: Phone portrait: rail corners clip the frame edge and the Live preview pill sits on the wood
issues.detail: In shots/critic-r2-phone/settings.phone.classic.png the near rail's rounded corners run into the preview frame's left and right edges (x~30 and x~795 of the 824px capture) so there is no void either side at the widest point, and only ~14 CSS px of void beneath the near bevel; the 'LIVE PREVIEW' badge (left 12, bottom 10) therefore overlaps the wood rail rather than floating in the parlour void as it does on desktop and phone-landscape. Fix: for aspects below ~1.9 back the camera off slightly (e.g. PREVIEW_CAMERA.position z 6.35 -> ~6.9, or PREVIEW_HFOV_DEG 52 -> ~56 in previewConfig.ts) so ~8-10 px of void separates the rail from the frame on all four sides, and/or move the badge to the top-left where the void is guaranteed. The three-settings spec's 'void below' assertion should then sample 8 px up with margin to spare.

issues.title: Blue back still reads cyan/pale toward the far edge
issues.detail: Measured centre of the face-down tile is #6b9db4 (phone) / #669ab3 (desktop): ΔE 3.5-3.7 against the Blue gradient, which is fine, but the far (top) edge is ΔE 5.5 (phone) and 6.8 (desktop) from the #7fa9c1 top stop and visibly cooler/more cyan than the chip. Plum behaves the same (far edge ΔE 9-10 vs top stop, 4 vs gradient). The single global albedo x0.8 / chroma x1.4 in compensateBackColor over-saturates cool hues. Fix: compensate per hue (e.g. saturation 1.25 for blue/mint, 1.4 for plum) or raise uBackRoughness toward 0.85 so the key's specular lift on the far edge drops; re-measure both edges, not just the centre.

issues.title: Desktop dpr 1 preview shows stair-step aliasing on tile edges and glyph strokes
issues.detail: At 3x zoom of shots/critic-r2-desktop/settings-jade-plum.desktop.classic.png the tile silhouettes and the 五/萬/發 strokes have visible jaggies; antialias:true is requested in SceneHost but SwiftShader does not honour MSAA, and the canvas is only 403x236 CSS px. Because the preview is tiny (6.6k tris, 5 draw calls) it can afford supersampling: render at min(2, dpr*2) via the new maxDpr path when dpr < 1.5, or add an FXAA/SMAA pass on desktop only. Verify on a real GPU before deciding whether this is SwiftShader-only.

issues.title: No hover state on skin chips or segmented controls
issues.detail: The visual language specifies hover = translateY(-1px) + brightness(1.05) over 160 ms for buttons; SkinChip and Segmented in SettingsPanel.tsx only style the pressed state (scale 0.97, surfaceHi). On a pointer device the chips feel inert until clicked. Fix: use Pressable's onHoverIn/onHoverOut (react-native-web supports them) to set a hovered style with the 1 px lift and a brightness filter, with a 160 ms transition.

issues.title: Status pill and Live preview badge use 10 px labels (spec is 11 px)
issues.detail: StatusPill text ('CLASSIC ACTIVE') is fontSize 10 with letterSpacing 1.2 and the 'LIVE PREVIEW' badge is fontSize 10 / letterSpacing 2; the shared language says small labels are 11 px, uppercase, 2 px tracking, weight 700. Contrast is fine (0.62 white over glass ~7:1) but 10 px at dpr 1 is at the edge of comfortable. Bump both to 11 px and align the pill's tracking to 2 px.

issues.title: match-dealt (table-owned) exceeds the triangle budget: 159,938 > 150,000
issues.detail: Zero errors on all three viewports, but budget.violations lists 'triangles 159938 > 150000' on each; the number is byte-identical to round 1 (critic-r1-phone-3d) and comes from the placeholder Table3DShell (3 draw calls, renders 1). Not attributable to the settings subsystem, so it is not counted against perfPass here — the orchestrator should keep gating it on the table subsystem. The warmupMs split (236-676 ms) and the gl.finish() change did remove the multi-second frame-2 stall seen in r1 (p95 2.2 -> steady-state 0 with renders 1).

issues.title: Phone landscape stage is small with ~45% of the canvas as empty void
issues.detail: The 570x150 letterbox keeps both rails in frame (void luminance 0.006 above / 0.009 below, verified), but the rail occupies only ~55% of the width and the tiles are ~40 CSS px tall — legible but modest. Options: let PREVIEW_MAX_ASPECT rise to ~2.4 so the stage uses more width while still keeping void above/below, or grow previewHeight to ~170 px at height < 520 by trimming the section gap (22 -> 16) in the landscape layout.

issues.title: Landscape basics-0: spotlight ring bisects the hand row
issues.detail: The dice modal overlaps the own-hand row in landscape (table-owned), but the ring drawn around it is tutorial-owned and its bottom stroke at y≈375 CSS cuts straight through every hand tile: pixel sample of tile 東 body is 251,248,240 (lit) at y≈356 and 41,42,37 (dimmed) at y≈385. Tiles 六..發 read as half-lit / half-dark with a gold line across them — this is the very first coach-mark a landscape user sees. encloseStraddlers does not help because the hand rect straddles by far more than STRADDLE_MAX (24 px). Fix: when the target rect intersects a large avoid rect (hand row) by more than STRADDLE_MAX, trim the focus/ring to the modal's portion above that rect and treat the bottom side as 'tight' (drop the stroke + feather it the way the screen-edge open side is handled), or move the landscape dice modal above the hand in the table shell. Either way the ring must not cross tiles.

issues.title: Phone scoring-1: card floats 90 px below the ring, notch points at dimmed Rules chips
issues.detail: The focus band ring ends at y≈440 CSS and the card starts at y≈530; the intervening 90 px is the dimmed 'Rules / Minimum faan 0 1 3 5' remainder of the result panel (column sample at x=206: gold at 440, scrim-grey 77,78,74 from 450–520, card at 530). The notch tip lands between the faan pills and visually points at 'Rules', not at the spotlit score header. The keepNotch-over-keepClear rule keeps the arrow but the composition still reads as 'look at the rules chips'. Fix: when the gap is entirely the target's own dimmed remainder, dock snug — top = haloBottom + CARD_GAP — and let the (already solid) card cover the remainder; the buttons below are hidden by the scrim anyway. Alternatively drop the notch when gap > NOTCH_MAX_GAP regardless of keepClear.

issues.title: Landscape scoring-1: ring lights the opponent seat strip and desktop seat badges
issues.detail: Landscape: the ring top sits at y≈13 CSS while the result panel top is at ≈33, so '西 Niko  Bot (Easy)' and '北 Tao' from the seat strip sit inside the lit hole (sample 51,60,52 vs 39,49,41 dimmed) and read as part of the lesson target. Desktop: the tops of the Kai 北 / Tao 南 seat badges peek lit above the panel edge inside the ring. Looks like the straddler enclosure pulling unrelated chrome in. Fix: only enclose straddlers whose centre lies inside the ring, or exclude seat-strip / seat-badge rects from candidates so the ring hugs the focus band (HALO_PAD 8) on the top side.

issues.title: Landscape scoring-intro step 0: centred card reads off-centre and kisses the hand row
issues.detail: placeCentred slides the 'Scoring 101' card left/up to clear the Order/Player toggle: it now spans x 163–601 CSS in a 915 px viewport (centre 382 vs 457) and its bottom edge at ≈345 sits 5 px above the hand tiles at ≈350. The intent is clear from the code but the result looks accidentally misaligned next to the perfectly centred basics-1 / claims-0 cards. Fix: prefer a purely vertical shift or a slightly narrower card when the only conflict is a small toggle, or treat the toggle as coverable (card already paints solid when overlapsChrome) and keep the card horizontally centred; keep ≥ 12 px to the hand row.

issues.title: Progress dots and 'LESSON N/14' label count different things
issues.detail: Header reads 'LESSON 1/14' while the dot row shows 6 dots (steps within the lesson); on basics-1 the label still says 1/14 but the 2nd dot is active. First-time users will read the dots as lesson progress. Fix: add a tiny 'Step 2 of 6' caption beside the dots or move the lesson counter to the lesson-picker and keep the card header about steps only.

issues.title: 3D renderer: targeted steps still fall back to the centred card (known gap)
issues.detail: Zero errors and budget passes (3 draw calls, 159,938 tris, programs 3, idle on desktop) and the dice-modal step rings correctly because the modal is DOM. But per the engineer's own gap list the 3D table registers no <TutorialTarget> rects, so own-hand / wall / discard steps will show a targetless card once the 3D table lands. Not scored heavily this pre-integration round, but it is the next blocker for the tutorial on the real renderer: mount Tutorial3D / setSpotlightTiles and register projected tile rects.
